attributes.title: 2027 APHON 51st Annual Conference and Exhibition
attributes.summary:
The Association of Pediatric Hematology/Oncology Nurses holds its 51st Annual Conference and Exhibition from September 29 to October 1, 2027, at the Pasadena Convention Center in Pasadena, California. The theme is "Heart & Science in Action." The meeting serves nurses who care for children and young adults with cancer and blood disorders.

The call for abstracts opens December 18, 2026. APHON lists three recommended hotels near the convention center: Hotel Dena and The Westin Pasadena at $239 per night and Hyatt Place Pasadena at $259 per night with breakfast, all before taxes and fees. Registration fees and contact hours had not been posted when we checked.
